title: TABLE 63 DIVINATION RESULTS - the five omen bands with the party, foe, encounter, reaction, save and travel modifiers
audit_comment: OA round fifty-three (capture p. 117): Table 63 - the divination results of the omen spell, the five 1d10 bands with their mechanical modifiers, cross-checked between the passes

banner.title: TABLE 63 DIVINATION RESULTS, printed capture p. 117 - the OA divination results round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print p. 117; compressed pp. 59-60); the five band rows cross-checked line by line between the passes, zero contested reads - the only OCR variance is typographic (the compressed dropping a period on the neutral row and a stray quote mark on the favorable to hit line). The table answers the omen spell: a 1d10 rolled when the DM has no information on which to base his judgment. The bands pin as a chain (the die roll mapped to its band: 1-2 ill omen, 3-4 great danger, 5-7 neutral, 8-9 favorable, 10 auspicious - the neutral band the widest at three faces) and a six-column grid: the party to hit and save modifiers, the foe to hit modifier, the encounter chance multiplier, the reaction modifier and the travel boost. The ill omen band is conditional: the -1 party penalties apply only if the characters ignore the advice (the diaIllOmenIgnorePenalty pin), while the doubled encounters and the -10% reaction apply outright - great danger shares the doubled encounters and the reaction penalty and adds the adversaries to hit at +1. The favorable band travels at half again the normal rate (pinned +50 percent) with opponents to hit at -1; the auspicious band stacks all the favorable effects plus the +1 on all saving throws that day. The band names ride the column comments, the omen prose closes in its own round. The table tag T63Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson

col_comments: the party to hit modifier by band (print p. 117; compressed pp. 59-60). The band list rides this comment: 0 ill omen, 1 great danger, 2 neutral, 3 favorable, 4 auspicious - the -1 applies only in the ill omen band, and there only if the advice is ignored (the diaIllOmenIgnorePenalty pin); the other bands carry no party to hit modifier

the party saving throw modifier by band (print p. 117; compressed pp. 59-60). The band list rides this comment: 0 ill omen, 1 great danger, 2 neutral, 3 favorable, 4 auspicious - the -1 in the ill omen band (again only if the advice is ignored) and the +1 in the auspicious band; great danger, neutral and favorable carry none

the foe to hit modifier by band (print p. 117; compressed pp. 59-60). The band list rides this comment: 0 ill omen, 1 great danger, 2 neutral, 3 favorable, 4 auspicious - the adversaries gain +1 in the great danger band and suffer -1 against the characters in the favorable and auspicious bands; the ill omen and neutral bands carry none

the encounter chance multiplier by band (print p. 117; compressed pp. 59-60). The band list rides this comment: 0 ill omen, 1 great danger, 2 neutral, 3 favorable, 4 auspicious - the chance for encounters is doubled in the ill omen and great danger bands (pinned 2), the other three bands the normal 1

the reaction modifier by band (print p. 117; compressed pp. 59-60). The band list rides this comment: 0 ill omen, 1 great danger, 2 neutral, 3 favorable, 4 auspicious - the -10 reaction modifier (pinned as a percentage, the diaReactionPenaltyPct const) applies to all encounters in the ill omen and great danger bands; the other bands carry none

the travel rate boost by band (print p. 117; compressed pp. 59-60). The band list rides this comment: 0 ill omen, 1 great danger, 2 neutral, 3 favorable, 4 auspicious - the favorable and auspicious bands travel at half again their normal traveling rate that day (pinned 1, the +50 percent riding the diaTravelBoostPct const); the other bands carry none
